entries.zh: 排气、放屁；出气、喘息
entries.en: to pass wind, to break wind; to breathe out, pant
entries.notes: 西注「pasar el viento, o resuello」兼指排气与气息，汉字「朝氣」（tiān-khì）与其对应不直白，释义以西注 17 世纪义为主。

entries.zh: 径直通过、照直走过；度过一生（两栏义不合，并存）
entries.en: to pass straight on; to pass one's life (si. la vida)
entries.notes: 西注「pasar la vida（过活/度日）」与汉字「直過（径直通过）」义不相应，至少一栏有讹，两义并存。

entries.zh: 度日、过日子（勉强维持过活）
entries.en: to pass one's days, to get by / scrape along

entries.zh: 通过、通行；首字「托」义不明
entries.en: to pass through (further sense uncertain)
entries.notes: 西栏与官话栏均空缺，首字「托」（音 tog）义待考，仅「通過」一义可确解。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to pass suddenly / at one stroke (si. pasar de golpe)
entries.notes: 汉字/闽南/官话三栏空缺；西语「desolpe」疑为「de golpe」之讹（骤然通过），拼写待考。

entries.zh: 温书、温习功课（把书通读一遍）
entries.en: to go through a book reading it, to review a book

entries.zh: 温习功课至熟、背到烂熟（温迄伊熟：温到它熟为止）
entries.en: to go over the lesson until it is known by heart, to recite it from memory
entries.notes: 汉字「乞」疑为「迄（直到）」之借字；据西注「凭记忆温课/背诵」释义。

entries.zh: 跨过去、从上面越过
entries.en: to pass over something, to step over it
entries.notes: 首字「跌/跋」存疑（跋＝徒步跨过，与西注合），据西注「pasar por encima（从上面经过）」释义。

entries.zh: 火焰窜过、火苗烧过
entries.en: the flame passes over; to pass through the fire
entries.notes: 「焰/燄」为同字异体，不碍义；封存件标 [疑] 故降级。

entries.zh: 躐越、跳过；越级逾序
entries.en: to leap over; to skip / overstep the (proper) order
entries.notes: 末字「芋/芧」存疑，音 têng 疑与「等」合（躐等＝越级逾序），恰合西注「pasar por salto；pasar orden（跳跃而过；逾越次序）」。

entries.zh: 历经岁月、年岁递过
entries.en: to pass through ages, to grow old
entries.notes: 次字「上/卜」存疑且与闽南音 lek 不合，义据西注「pasar edades（历经岁月）」。

entries.zh: 历代、历经世代更迭
entries.en: to pass through generations, age after age

entries.zh: 历年、年复一年地过去
entries.en: to pass years, year after year

entries.zh: 错过时机而落后、落在后面
entries.en: to let the occasion slip by; to be left behind
entries.notes: 西注「时机错过（pasarse la ocasión）」与汉字「落后」义近而不全同，释义取其相合处。

entries.zh: 错过救治时机、过了可治之期（汉字「過証」义待考）
entries.en: the time of remedy has passed, past cure
entries.notes: 汉字「証」与西注「救治之时已过」的对应待考，释义以西注为主。

entries.zh: 渐渐度日、日子一天天慢慢过去
entries.en: the days pass little by little; to pass one's days gradually

entries.zh: 越过头顶、没提防就从头上过去
entries.en: to pass over one's head without one's foreseeing it
entries.notes: 「過頭」此处取「越过头顶」义（闽南语另有「过分」义），合于西注「未经预见而掠过（no lo prevenir）」。

entries.zh: 不知头绪、弄不明白
entries.en: not to understand it, to be at a loss

entries.zh: 纸被水/墨浸透过、纸濡透过去
entries.en: the paper gets soaked / wet through (of moisture passing over it)
entries.notes: 「濡/濕」存疑，据汉字「紙濡過去」与西注「纸被透过」释义。

entries.zh: 迟过限期、误了期限
entries.en: to pass the deadline, to exceed the appointed term
entries.notes: 闽南栏仅记一音节「tan」，与两字汉字「遲限」不全对应，据西、汉两栏释义。

entries.zh: 迟误、误了期限
entries.en: to be delayed past the deadline, to delay and miss the term

entries.zh: 玩耍消遣、寻欢作乐（消遣、欢愉、自娱）
entries.en: pastime, recreation; to amuse oneself, take pleasure, indulge oneself
entries.notes: 闽南音两节（guan-loi）而汉字仅「玩」一字，次音对应字不明；西注缩写「j.」未展开，据 holgarse/alegría/regalarse（消遣、欢愉、自娱）释义。
